sentences.en: Their culture values obedience to those in positions of authority.
sentences.zh: 他们的文化重视对权威人物的服从。

sentences.en: Probably, the prime minister means 'politics based on religious values.'
sentences.zh: 也许首相的意思是‘基于宗教价值观的政治’。

sentences.en: Our lifestyle is modern but oriented to Islamic traditional values.
sentences.zh: 我们的生活方式是现代的，但倾向于伊斯兰教的传统价值观。
